items.title: 壊すことが，次に壊す理由になる。「ドンキーコング バナンザ」のゲームサイクルはこう組み立てられた［CEDEC 2026］
items.summary: 2025年7月にNintendoSwitch2向けに発売された「ドンキーコングバナンザ」は，地形も敵も装飾物も，目に見えるものをほぼすべて壊せるアクションゲームだ。その「破壊」というコンセプトをどう遊びとして成立させたのか，ゲームデザインとプログラム，両方の視点から本作のディレクター2名が語ったセッションをレポートしよう。

zh.title: 破坏某件事会成为下一次破坏它的理由。这就是“Donkey Kong Bananza”游戏周期的组装方式 [CEDEC 2026]
zh.summary: 《Donkey Kong Bananza》于 2025 年 7 月在 Nintendo Switch 2 上发布，是一款动作游戏，你可以摧毁几乎所有你看到的东西，包括地形、敌人和装饰品。我们来报道一下这个游戏的两位导演从游戏设计和编程两个角度谈论“毁灭”这个概念是如何实现为游戏的一个环节。

en.title: Breaking something becomes a reason to break it next. This is how the game cycle of "Donkey Kong Bananza" was assembled [CEDEC 2026]
en.summary: ``Donkey Kong Bananza'', released for Nintendo Switch 2 in July 2025, is an action game where you can destroy almost everything you see, including terrain, enemies, and decorations. Let's report on a session in which the two directors of this game talked about how the concept of "destruction" was realized as a play, from both the perspectives of game design and programming.

zh.title: Switch 2 版《我们地狱》最新预告片已发布。在90秒的视频中介绍自由探索和激烈战斗
zh.summary: 3goo 今天发布了 Switch 2 版《我们地狱》的最新预告片。这段90秒的视频介绍了本作的魅力，包括不依赖标记或日志的自由探索、以毁灭的哈迪亚世界为背景的故事，以及与名为Calamity的超自然生物的战斗。

en.title: The latest trailer for the Switch 2 version of "Hell is Us" has been released. Introducing free exploration and fierce battles in a 90-second video
en.summary: 3goo today released the latest trailer for the Switch 2 version of ``Hell is Us''. The 90-second video introduces the appeal of this work, including free exploration without relying on markers or logs, a story set in the devastated world of Hadea, and battles with supernatural beings called Calamity.

en.summary: I often talk to my friends about how amazing I was when I first saw Halo 4. When you have experienced a thrilling battle in the cave and passed through the dark tunnel, a hole suddenly opens up in front of you - as the halo in front of you dissipates, what you see is: huge ancient civilization buildings soaring into the sky; alien fleets in the distance shuttle back and forth; huge spaceships nearby are emitting thick smoke... At that moment, I felt that what was displayed on the screen was simply a huge landscape art that could never be presented in reality. But whenever I talk about this part, I will be interrupted by those old fans of the Halo series: "Hold on hold on, buddy, are you so excited to play "Halo 4"? Then you must experience the charm of the old "Halo" for yourself." But I am ashamed to say that over the years, no matter what kind of remake Halo has gone through, for me, the graphics performance, special effects, and even operating habits of the original "Campaign Evolved" have always been the same.

ja.summary: ゲスト：BrusH カバー・編集・ポストプロダクション：Ac 2026年の中国ヒップホップは、いわゆる「大方言時代」に突入した。ラップミュージックと地元の方言を組み合わせるのは、何も新しいことではありません。エントロピー増大に伴う内容の偏りに加え、方言とラップの相性も常に話題となる。方言とフロウの組み合わせは、方言ラップのリスニング体験の基礎であり、ミュージシャンの理解力と表現力をテストする重要な部分でもあります。この回では、キャスター3名とゲストのBrushが一緒に歌を聴きます。過去1～2年に6つの地域から集めた方言ラップ作品をセレクトしました。これらの方言はヒップホップ市場では一般的ではなく、好まれないものもあります。しかし、作り手は方言と流れの有機的な結合をさまざまな方法や角度で実現しており、十分に評価に値する成果も生み出している。一緒にこのプログラムに参加して、誰もが慣れ親しんでいる南西北京語以外にどのような方言ラップがあるのか​​見てみましょう。

en.summary: Guest: BrusH cover/editing/post-production: Ac Chinese hip-hop in 2026 has entered the so-called "big dialect era". Matching rap music with hometown dialect is nothing new. In addition to the uneven content accompanying the increase in entropy, the compatibility between different dialects and rap is always a topic for discussion. The combination of dialect and flow is the cornerstone of the listening experience of dialect rap, and it is also an important part of testing the musician's ability to understand and present. In this episode, three anchors and guest Brush listen to songs together - we have selected dialect rap works from six different regions in the past 1-2 years. These dialects are not common in the hip-hop market, and some are even not favored. However, the creators have achieved the organic combination of dialects and flow in different ways and angles, and they have also produced results that are quite worthy of appreciation. Let's go into this program together and see what other dialect raps there are besides the Southwest Mandarin that everyone is more accustomed to.

Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it. It looked ten centimeters in diameter. I didn’t understand how the slender vine could carry nutrients to three meters.

zh.summary: 据透露，eBay 和三名未被刑事起诉的高管已同意就 2019 年发生的一对记者夫妇的骚扰事件支付总计约 5600 万美元（约 91.6 亿日元）的赔偿金，包括和解金和捐款。 阅读更多...

en.title: eBay and former executive agree to pay $56 million to settle civil lawsuit over journalist harassment case
en.summary: It has been revealed that eBay and three executives who were not criminally prosecuted have agreed to pay a total of approximately $56 million (approximately 9.16 billion yen), including settlement money and donations, over the harassment incident against a journalist couple that occurred in 2019. read more...
